editorial:
Ever wondered how far a family would go to make a grandma happy? You get to see that in this hilarious story about a Mexican family who decides to pull off a massive prank for love. Instead of spending a fortune on a real flight to Europe, they decide to build a fake version of a small Italian town right there in Mexico. The vibe is warm, chaotic, and full of heart, making you feel like you are part of this crazy family gathering. It is a sweet look at how much people will do for their elders, all wrapped up in a funny plot that keeps you smiling.

What really makes this work is the acting and the funny situations that pop up when the fake town starts to fall apart. While some parts move a bit slow, the charm of the characters makes up for it. If you love family comedies with a lot of soul, you definitely need to see this one. It is the perfect movie to watch with your own parents or grandparents.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the Nonna finally realizes that she never actually left Mexico. Instead of being upset, she feels overwhelmed with love because she sees how hard her family worked just to see her smile. The movie wraps up with the whole family hugging and celebrating their bond. It ends on a high note, showing that the effort and love they put into the lie were more important than the actual destination.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies and stories about unconditional love.
